description: Retrieve an object. Encrypted objects (the default for anything stored through this server) are decrypted automatically with the local key; retrieval from a machine without that key will fail, which is the intended property. Small text objects return inline; pass local_path for anything else. WRITES TO DISK: passing local_path writes the bytes to that path and overwrites any existing file there, so treat it as a write operation and confirm the path with your human first.

local_path.description: Save to this path instead of returning inline. Overwrites an existing file.

name: get
title: Retrieve an object
